_comment: Article URLs that were published on main and no longer render, mapped to their successor. Keyed by locale; 'en' is the root. Sources: git rename detection over _posts/ on first-parent main, plus each locale's slugs.json history replayed through the builder rule OUT/EN_TO_FR.get(slug, slug). postbuild_lib.redirects materialises each key as a redirect page. Deliberately NOT listed: 2024-04-13-a-quantum-breakthrough-in-lattice-cryptography, removed with no successor — it stays a 404, which is the honest response for deleted content.
